text_block_list.text:
Нарита Брайан and I head to the shopping
district to
buy some equipment one day
after training.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: ...What's going on over there?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Step right up and try your luck with our
New
Year's raffle! This year's grand prize
is a hot
spring vacation for two!
text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk

text_block_list.text:
First-prize winners get a deluxe carrot
hamburger
steak! Second-prize winners
get a bushel of
carrots! And third-prize
winners can take home a
single carrot!
text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk

text_block_list.text:
Don't let this opportunity pass you by!
Get a
ticket now and spin for your
chance to win!
text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk

text_block_list.text:
So, it's a raffle. Come to think of it,
didn't you get
a ticket earlier?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан
choice_data_list: Want to give it a go?

text_block_list.text:
Well there's no point in not using it,
right?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: ...Okay.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Hand it over.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
My sister always says that I'm good at
turning the
tumbler. Just watch.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
I hand the raffle ticket to a strangely
confidant
Нарита Брайан.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She steps up boldly and spins the lever
of the
raffle machine.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
A small plastic ball drops from the
tumbler's
opening...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Holy mackerel! We've got ourselves a
grand-prize
winner! Come and get the
ticket for your hot
spring vacation!
Congratulations!
text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk

text_block_list.text:
Вы получили:
<itemname>
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Oh... the grand prize.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Haha, you're a little too happy. You
look just like
my sister.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Every time I won a prize, she would clap
her
hands and run up to get it.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
But that's ancient history. Anyway, I'll
give you
the prize this time.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Why not? You're the one who got the
ticket to
play in the first place.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
All I did was spin the lever. If anyone
deserves the
prize, it's you.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан
choice_data_list: But you went to all the trouble...

text_block_list.text: ...Hah. You're taking this too seriously.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Fine. I'll use it when I decide the time is
right.
Okay?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Looks like we have another first-prize
winner!
Congratulations! You get one
deluxe carrot
hamburger steak!
text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk

text_block_list.text:
Вы получили:
<itemname>
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Hm... Another delicious-looking prize.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Oho, you've got a good eye! Actually, the retail value of this hamburger steak is... mumble, mumble.
text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk

text_block_list.text:
What?! Are you insane, giving away
something
this extravagant as a raffle
prize?!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: ...Gulp.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
I recommend you eat it soon. All food is
best
when it's fresh!
text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk

text_block_list.text:
Let's hurry back and get cooking,
Trainer.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Who knew you could get meat like this
from a
raffle...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
We got a second-prize winner! It's your
lucky day!
You're going home with a
bushel of carrots!
text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk

text_block_list.text:
Вы получили:
<itemname>
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Oh, we won something..
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Not bad, getting second prize and all!
text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk

text_block_list.text:
...Come on, don't praise me over
something like
this. It's embarrassing.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: ...I said cut it out already. Geez...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Would you lookie here! You've won the
third
prize! Here's your carrot!
text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk

text_block_list.text:
Вы получили:
<itemname>
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: ...Third place.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан
choice_data_list: Winning anything at all is still lucky!

text_block_list.text: ...Hmph.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Yeah, I guess so. Raffles are like that.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
At least the prize is a carrot. It's good
luck
getting something I can eat.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Ohhh, tough luck! Looks like you pulled
a blank
one! Take this pack of tissues as
a consolation
prize.
text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk

text_block_list.text:
Вы получили:
<itemname>
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: ...I lost?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
True. Playing a raffle you can't lose
would be
boring.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Everything happens by chance. Not
knowing what
will happen is exactly
what makes it interesting.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
...Although, winning still would've been
nicer.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Нарита Брайан and I head back to the
school faster
than usual.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
And so, Нарита Брайан ends up taking the
ticket for
the hot spring vacation.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Нарита Брайан takes the prize. Although
she's not a
fan of vegetables, it seems
that carrots are an
exception.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Her tail drops dejectedly and doesn't
perk up
again for a while after.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Нарита Брайан splits the carrots with me,
looking
slightly embarrassed.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
